VS Code Electron AXWebArea is allowed to reach the signed IDE gate only, never browser DOM; VS Code lacking a full-path target/ancestor document remains HOLD. Xcode with real Source Editor + editor context may use window-level fallback. No terminal, remote, symlink, unsigned or out-of-scope file delivery.
